title: LoveBud execution-group registry
description: Machine-readable registry of LoveBud test execution groups. Each group maps a set of tests to its execution characteristics, command reference, and risk-gate metadata. This is the execution-group authority, separate from the evidence-layer authority in tests/test-layer-classification.json.
baseline_sha_note: Exact implementation baseline. Updated when the registry is refreshed for a new child. Do not use as a Git reference path.
group_enum_note: Canonical ordered group vocabulary. Every group in this registry must appear in exactly this order in group_enum and in the same order in groups. Unknown, duplicate, misordered, or missing groups are fail-closed.
artifact_expectation_enum: command-defined; none registered by this child
combined TAP output from all default-CI groups

field_definitions.membership_source: How membership is determined. One of: classification_layer, package_glob, path_pattern, explicit_list.
field_definitions.explicit_paths: Array of normalized repository-relative file paths when membership_source is explicit_list. Null otherwise. No arguments, absolute paths, or traversal allowed.
field_definitions.command_reference: Shell command or npm script that executes the group, or NOT_EXECUTED for groups never executed by CI.
field_definitions.default_pr_execution_state: Default execution state for PR CI from execution_state_enum.
field_definitions.platform: Supported or observed platform from platform_enum.
field_definitions.capabilities: Array of required capabilities from capability_enum.

groups.purpose: Source-only static contract tests. Read source/docs/configuration and assert on strings, regex, file existence, structure, order, or syntax markers. Do not execute the asserted target runtime behavior.
groups.comparability: branch/main: same node --test command, same globs, deterministic per-path membership

groups.purpose: Fake/stub runtime contract tests. Execute production module source in node:vm with injected fake/mock/stub dependencies. No real external system or production resource used.
groups.comparability: branch/main: same node --test command, same globs, deterministic per-path membership

groups.purpose: Real local browser contract tests. Execute production CSS/JS in Playwright Chromium via a local HTTP server with real DOM rendering and computed style assertions. No production write/auth/API/DB mutation.
groups.comparability: branch/main: same node --test command, same globs, deterministic per-path membership; requires Playwright Chromium installation

groups.purpose: Real local process contract tests. Execute production module source in a real local process (Playwright or Node) without browser page rendering. Distinguished from BROWSER_REAL_LOCAL by test-asserted execution context (process-level vs browser page).
groups.comparability: branch/main: same node --test command, same globs, deterministic per-path membership

groups.purpose: Disposable PostgreSQL engine tests. Execute migration/repair/fixture SQL against ephemeral postgres:17.4 CI service containers. Never Production.
groups.comparability: branch/main: separate npm script per suite; test path matches tests/db-engine/; requires ephemeral PostgreSQL 17.4 service container

groups.purpose: Python supplemental tests executed outside the default Node CI chain. Separate command or manual run.
groups.command_reference: manual or separate Python invocation (non-default CI)

groups.purpose: Manual or remote/provider-gated scripts and commands. Recorded for inventory completeness. Never executed by this child. Active default-CI commands (e.g., scripts/pre-deploy.cjs via npm run verify) are excluded.
groups.command_reference: NOT_EXECUTED — recorded for inventory only; this child does not execute any remote/provider/manual command
groups.comparability: No branch/main dual execution defined. Execution requires operator or dedicated CI workflow.
groups.artifact_expectation: command-defined; none registered by this child

groups.purpose: Aggregate of all default-CI test groups. Executes every test file matched by the package.json test globs. This is an aggregate group that derives its membership from the package node --test command globs.
groups.comparability: branch/main: exact same npm test command and globs
groups.artifact_expectation: combined TAP output from all default-CI groups
